name: [Cartoon] Xerographic Cel Line
nl: Xerographic cel rendering: pencil drawings photocopied straight onto cels, scratchy doubled grey-black outlines, construction lines left in place, flat paint filling loosely inside the line, cartoon style image.
negative: clean traced inks, glossy digital colour

name: [Cartoon] Scratch-on-Film Direct
nl: Direct-on-film rendering: forms scratched and inked into the emulsion by hand, a jittering line that never repeats twice, raw flare along the sprocket side, dust and splice damage riding through, cartoon style image.

name: [Cartoon] Paint-on-Glass
nl: Paint-on-glass rendering: wet oils smeared and reworked under the camera, brush ridges catching the light, forms half-dissolving into one another, luminous backlit colour, cartoon style image.
negative: hard cel edges, flat vector fills

name: [Cartoon] Pinscreen Shadow
nl: Pinscreen rendering: an image formed by thousands of pins pushed to differing depths, tone made only from tiny cast shadows, soft grainy relief, an even matte grey field behind, cartoon style image.

name: [Cartoon] Squigglevision
nl: Squiggle rendering: every contour vibrating with hand-redrawn wobble, flat unshaded fills inside restless outlines, cheerfully crude proportions, plain colour cards behind, cartoon style image.

name: [Cartoon] Multiplane Painted Depth
nl: Multiplane rendering: painted layers stacked at different distances, crisp foreground detail against progressively hazier planes, atmospheric perspective mixed in paint, warm lamp-lit palette, painting style image.
negative: flat single-plane artwork, hard graphic edges

name: [Cartoon] Cutout Engraving Collage
nl: Cutout collage rendering: old engravings clipped out and hinged into new arrangements, hard scissor edges, line weights and greys frankly mismatched, flat coloured card behind them, collage style image.

name: [Cartoon] Motion Comic Limited
nl: Motion-comic rendering: finished comic artwork separated onto sliding layers, hard panel edges kept intact, print halftone still visible inside the drawing, painted backgrounds behind flat figures, comic style image.

name: [Anime] Kanada School Effects
nl: Kanada-school rendering: angular explosion shapes with cracked highlight rims, debris flung outward in hard cel shapes, exaggerated perspective smears, hot yellow-white cores, anime style image.

name: [Anime] Smear-Frame Sakuga
nl: Smear-frame rendering: deliberately distorted in-between drawings, limbs stretched into ribbons for a single beat, several ghosted contours at once, flat cel colour kept flat through the distortion, anime style image.

name: [Anime] Missile Swarm Trails
nl: Missile-swarm rendering: dozens of thin smoke trails spiralling in dense parallel curves, hard cel-shaded plumes, steep perspective on the trail bundle, high-contrast sky behind it, anime style image.

name: [Manga] Copy-Book Toner
nl: Copy-shop doujin rendering: toner-heavy monochrome printing, screentone crushed into flat black patches, line thickened and slightly ghosted, cheap absorbent paper stock, manga style image.

name: [Anime] OVA Airbrush Poster
nl: OVA airbrush rendering: airbrushed gradients over hand-inked line, chrome sparkle and hard rim light on every edge, deep purple-to-magenta sky wash, faint print halftone in the flats, anime style image.
negative: flat modern digital colour, lineless painting
